title: First coordinate as a normalized sign sum
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every sign vector $x$ of length $n$, the first coordinate of the normalized correlated sum formed from a pair whose first component is $x$ equals the normalized Rademacher sum of $x$, namely $(\sqrt n)^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^n x_i$, with signs interpreted as real numbers.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
caveat: At $n=0$, the reciprocal square root is interpreted as the real reciprocal of $\sqrt 0$, and the sum is empty.
